title: Onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.2: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers running small-footprint deployments have requested an optimized aurora-lite-3b variant. This PR onboards aurora-lite-3b v1.2 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles for common infra shapes, and automates changelog/release-note generation. The changeset includes: 1) canonical model metadata (model card, signature, quantization compatibility, tokenizer mapping), 2) performance profiles for our typical SKU families (single-GPU, multi-GPU sharded, and CPU fallback), 3) CI automation to append a changelog entry when a model is promoted to public catalog. Detailed description: - Metadata: added aurora-lite-3b-v1.2.yaml under models/aurora-lite/ with fields: description, authors, license, input/output schema, recommended quantization profiles, supported sequence lengths, and a minimal sample prompt for evals. - Perf profiles: added perf/aurora-lite-3b-v1.2/ with profile JSONs for default batch sizes and KV cache characteristics used by the serving runtime; profiles include baseline latency p50/p95, throughput (tokens/sec), GPU memory footprint, and recommended kernel flags. - Changelog automation: updated scripts/tools/changelog-generator to pick up model metadata 'release_notes' field and append a formatted entry to CHANGELOG.md on merge; unit tests added and a CI job to validate changelog format. Backwards compatibility: metadata follows existing model schema v2.1; perf profile knobs are additive and will not affect older entries. Testing: unit and integration tests added for metadata parsing, and perf smoke tests ran on ci-small and ci-gpu pipelines. Rollout plan: merged to main, will monitor perf-regression-dashboard for aurora-lite-3b over the next 48 hours and keep canary routing enabled for 10% of traffic. Related work: ENG-1582 (onboard aurora variants), PM-402 (catalog refresh), SUP-733 (customer request).
